meta.notes: CORRECTED mapping. Orders now come from view_reports.oms_sales_raw_optimized (the post-migration OMS table), NOT production.fact_order_item. fact_order_item stopped receiving retail-store orders on 2026-05-24 (all ~215 named stores have zero orders after that date; only online/D2C continues), so any window covering June 2026 onward was missing ~80% of orders and had AOV dragged down by the loss of higher-value retail sales. oms_sales_raw_optimized is partitioned on `date`, covers 2024-01-01..today, and combines retail + D2C (oms_retail 952,392 + oms_shopify_d2c 1,187,246 ~= its 2,106,469 rows). Rows are at shipment/tracking grain, so they MUST be deduplicated on order_item_doc_id before summing sales -- one observed order (OD-453007253-9187) has 1,600 rows for a single item; undeduplicated, whole-window sales overcounts by 9.2% and individual orders by up to 1600x. Dedupe ordering includes tiebreaks (sales DESC, tracking_doc_id DESC) because record_updated_at alone ties for 11,863 items whose sales differ, which made the total nondeterministic; the max-vs-min spread is <=0.2% of AOV.
